===
Assignment
===
x := 1;
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
      X: (Ident "x")
      Y: (ValueLiteral "1"))))

===
Assignment to indexed field
===
x[1].a := 2;
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
      X: (SelectorExpr
        X: (IndexExpr
          X: (Ident "x")
          Index: (ValueLiteral "1"))
        Sel: (Ident "a"))
      Y: (ValueLiteral "2"))))

===
Pre-increment statement
===
{ ++x; }
---
(Root
  Nodes: (BlockStmt
    Stmts: (ExprStmt
      Expr: (UnaryExpr Op: "++"
        X: (Ident "x")))))

===
Post-increment statement
===

---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (PostExpr Op: "++"
      X: (Ident "x"))))

===
Post-decrement statement
===
x--;
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (PostExpr Op: "--"
      X: (Ident "x"))))

===
Empty block
===
{}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (BlockStmt))

===
Nested blocks
===
{ { x := 1; } { y := 2; } }
---
(Root
  Nodes: (BlockStmt
    Stmts: (BlockStmt
      Stmts: (ExprStmt
        Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "x")
          Y: (ValueLiteral "1"))))
    Stmts: (BlockStmt
      Stmts: (ExprStmt
        Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "y")
          Y: (ValueLiteral "2"))))))

===

===

        Y: (ValueLiteral "1")))

        X: (Ident "y")
        Y: (ValueLiteral "2")))))

        Name: (Ident "v")
        Value: (ValueLiteral "omit")))))

        Type: (Ident "timer")

===

          X: (Ident "x")
          Y: (ValueLiteral "1"))))
    Else: (BlockStmt
      Stmts: (ExprStmt
        Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "x")
          Y: (ValueLiteral "2"))))))

===

(Root
  Nodes: (IfStmt Tok: "if" ElseTok: "else"

    Then: (BlockStmt

          X: (Ident "x")
          Y: (ValueLiteral "1"))))
    Else: (IfStmt Tok: "if" ElseTok: "else"
      Cond: (Ident "b")
      Then: (BlockStmt
        Stmts: (ExprStmt
          Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
            X: (Ident "x")
            Y: (ValueLiteral "2"))))
      Else: (BlockStmt
        Stmts: (ExprStmt
          Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
            X: (Ident "x")
            Y: (ValueLiteral "3")))))))

            Args: (ParenExpr)))))
    Cond: (BinaryExpr Op: ">"
      X: (Ident "i")
      Y: (ValueLiteral "0"))

        Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "x")
          Y: (Ident "i"))))))

===

  Nodes: (SelectStmt Tok: "select"

        Stmts: (ExprStmt
          Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
            X: (Ident "y")
            Y: (ValueLiteral "1")))))
    Body: (CaseClause Tok: "case"
      Case: (ParenExpr
        List: (ValueLiteral "2")
        List: (ValueLiteral "3"))
      Body: (BlockStmt
        Stmts: (ExprStmt
          Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
            X: (Ident "y")
            Y: (ValueLiteral "2")))))))

===

    Body: (CaseClause Tok: "case"

            X: (ValueLiteral "1")
            Y: (ValueLiteral "5"))))
      Body: (BlockStmt
        Stmts: (ExprStmt
          Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
            X: (Ident "y")
            Y: (ValueLiteral "1")))))

        List: (ValueLiteral "?"))

            Y: (ValueLiteral "2")))))))

===
Real-world: function body
===
{
const integer max := 10;
var integer sum := 0;
for (var integer i := 1; i <= max; i := i + 1) {
  if (i mod 2 == 0) { continue; }
  sum := sum + i;
}
return sum;
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (BlockStmt
    Stmts: (DeclStmt
      Decl: (ValueDecl KindTok: "const"
        Type: (Ident "integer")
        Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
          Name: (Ident "max")
          Value: (ValueLiteral "10"))))
    Stmts: (DeclStmt
      Decl: (ValueDecl KindTok: "var"
        Type: (Ident "integer")
        Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
          Name: (Ident "sum")
          Value: (ValueLiteral "0"))))
    Stmts: (ForStmt Tok: "for"
      Init: (DeclStmt
        Decl: (ValueDecl KindTok: "var"
          Type: (Ident "integer")
          Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
            Name: (Ident "i")
            Value: (ValueLiteral "1"))))
      Cond: (BinaryExpr Op: "<="
        X: (Ident "i")
        Y: (Ident "max"))
      Post: (ExprStmt
        Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
          X: (Ident "i")
          Y: (BinaryExpr Op: "+"
            X: (Ident "i")
            Y: (ValueLiteral "1"))))
      Body: (BlockStmt
        Stmts: (IfStmt Tok: "if"
          Cond: (BinaryExpr Op: "=="
            X: (BinaryExpr Op: "mod"
              X: (Ident "i")
              Y: (ValueLiteral "2"))
            Y: (ValueLiteral "0"))
          Then: (BlockStmt
            Stmts: (BranchStmt Tok: "continue")))
        Stmts: (ExprStmt
          Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
            X: (Ident "sum")
            Y: (BinaryExpr Op: "+"
              X: (Ident "sum")
              Y: (Ident "i"))))))
    Stmts: (ReturnStmt Tok: "return"
      Result: (Ident "sum"))))
